name: css-composite-font
description: Composite Font Studio · 复合字体工坊 · 複合字型工坊 · 合成フォント工房 — InDesign-style composite fonts for CJK and Western text, tuned per weight. Export CSS, TTF / OTF / WOFF2, or app code.

paragraphs: Combine CJK and Western fonts with separate sizes, baselines and weights, then export the result for websites or design apps—like InDesign’s composite fonts.
Try it in your browser · English / 简体中文 / 繁體中文 / 日本語
A font-family fallback chooses a font for each character, but does not balance their size or baseline. Composite Font Studio lets you tune that balance and keep it consistent across weights.
features: Compose by character class. Choose fonts, sizes and baselines for Han, kana, Western text, digits and punctuation, with custom exception characters.
Match fonts across weights. Auto-adjust size, baseline and available weights, then fine-tune individual steps or use a continuous variable-font range.
Bring your fonts. Search Google Fonts and installed families, or import font files. Inspect font information and character-set coverage before applying a choice.
Proof as you work. Edit proof text directly and check mixed-script text, missing glyphs and regional typography in a live preview.
Export where you need it. Generate CSS or TTF / OTF / WOFF2 files for design and office apps. Swift / Kotlin / Flutter code export is experimental.

whatItDoes.text: Combine CJK and Western fonts with separate sizes, baselines and weights, then export the result for websites or design apps—like InDesign’s composite fonts.

requirements.text: Keep presets in your browser or share an editable configuration link without an account.
